messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: PGD_INC_7213 fired for gpu-rt11-node12 — symptom: kernel panic + kubelet NotReady. Auto-page to oncall rotation. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PGD_INC_7213
Maya: acked. I'm on it. Collecting initial logs, paging primary infra.
Raj: I'm second oncall, standing by for handoff if needed.
Maya: quick summary — node gpu-rt11-node12 in rack r7 dropped, host unreachable from cluster for ~15s then returned, kubelet flapping NotReady. I see kernel oops in dmesg around the same time.
Maya: grabbing serial logs and journalctl now.
infra-bot: Serial console attached: https://console.example/serial/gpu-rt11-node12. Kernel oops excerpt:
```
[ 1234.567890] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
[ 1234.567900] CPU: 3 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/3 Tainted: G           O 5.15.0-rt
[ 1234.568000] Hardware name: AcmeRack GPU-1
```
Maya: kubelet logs show repeated: `E0903 12:20:11 kubelet.go:2894] Failed to update node status` then `NodeNotReady`
Jun: can you check pod eviction status? which tenants are on that node?
Maya: running `kubectl get pods -o wide --all-namespaces --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-rt11-node12`
```
NAMESPACE     NAME                                    READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   NODE
ml-prod       llm-infer-0                              1/1     Running   0          3d   gpu-rt11-node12
video         render-worker-5                          1/1     Running   0          1d   gpu-rt11-node12
telemetry     log-shipper-7                            0/1     Pending   0          2h   gpu-rt11-node12
```
Maya: looks like two production workloads: `ml-prod/llm-infer` (customer-facing low-latency API) and `video/render` (batch). Potential customer impact on inference for a subset of pods during the flapping window.
Alex (CS): heads-up — I have an open customer thread with BigRetail that mentioned occasional 503s this morning. I'll correlate.
Maya: NTP drift? I see repeated `audit: type=1334 ...` noise but no clear clock jump.
Raj: can you try cordon/drain to migrate pods off before it goes full kernel panic? If node recovers we'll uncordon.
Maya: attempting safe drain: `kubectl cordon gpu-rt11-node12 && kubectl drain gpu-rt11-node12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force --grace-period=60`
Maya: drain hung on `llm-infer-0` due to GPU driver exclusive lock. Trying `kubectl drain --timeout=10m` blocked.
Maya: triggering remote power cycle via IPMI as a last resort in maintenance window. Notified infra.
infra-bot: IPMI power cycle scheduled: BMC ipmi://r7/slot11 -> power off; wait 15s; power on. ETA 2m.
Maya: creating short runbook note for CS and SRE: node flapping -> cordon -> drain -> ipmi-cycle -> RMA if hw reoccurs.
Jun: metrics — the inference service p99 latency spiked to 1.8s and error rate to 6% across frontends for the shard served by that rack. Not global, but visible in telemetry.
Alex (CS): telling BigRetail: we see a transient backend node flap affecting a subset of inference capacity; we're mitigating. Will update in 10 min.
Maya: node powered cycle executed. Waiting for host to POST IPMI power on.
infra-bot: Host ping responding. Kernel boot. kubelet starting.
Maya: kubelet is back, node status transitions to Ready after image garbage collector finished. Uncordoning to let scheduler place work back: `kubectl uncordon gpu-rt11-node12`
Maya: observing pods reschedule. `ml-prod/llm-infer-0` came back on a different host — traffic rebalanced.
Jun: monitoring for 30m for recurrence. If kernel oops repeats, open an RMA and we escalate to hardware team.
Maya: leaving note: `incidentbot:manual` — temporary paging resolved, customer-visible impact contained to ~4 minutes for the shard.
Raj: taking over for the watch window. I'll monitor metrics and keep CS looped. Handoff: Maya -> Raj.
Maya: handing off. Key items: watch dmesg for repeated oops, check nvidia-driver versions across rack (matching patch 540.44), verify power-cycling didn't leave any degraded RAID/PMU alerts.
Raj: ack handoff. I'll run a full health sweep and file postmortem if we see recurrence. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PGD_INC_7213 acknowledged by Maya. Escalation if unacked for 8m will go to Jun.
